procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
FRA 57041 was represented by Norah Dal Fabbro Casier
facts: Time and date of the decision of the original hearing: 23 July - 16:35.
The request to reopen hearing no. 7 was lodged on 24 July - 16:50.
conclusions: FRA 57041 failed to request the reopening of the hearing within 24 hours after being informed of the decision, as required by RRS 63.7(b). Therefore, the request to reopen is invalid.
decision: Hearing No.7 will not be reopened.
